item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las o rgyan dur khrod mjal snang bka' bab lung bstan byung tshul
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub zab mo gnang tshul dang / bka'i zhu gleng mdzad tshul zur tsam 'di/ snyigs ma'i kho bo pad+ma NaM drung mu yi/ gsang mtshan badz+ra zhes pa'i rnal 'byor bdag gsang ba'i gnas mchog bya khri 'bar ba ru/ lhun grub nyams dga' rin chen spungs pa'i khrod/ dus dang rten 'brel 'dzom pa bdag gis bkod//
